name: Shared Interstage — Finish Group
intent: Shared between-coat tasks for a finish_group_assignment pass: inspect cured coat, sand between, patch defects, spot-coat, clean dust. Fires ONCE per group. Per-substrate MOD_INTERSTAGE_TRIM instances gate off via applies_when: { pass_group_id: [null] }. Mirrors MOD_INTERSTAGE_TRIM task list.
doctrine: V1a finish_group_assignment shared interstage. Task_refs mirror MOD_INTERSTAGE_TRIM. Trim interstage is mandatory for all QTs (semi-gloss/satin finish magnifies defects) so this module always fires when the group has finish_coats >= 2.
